$description: What is enforced vs convention for token use.

rawValueRestrictions.color: Reference color.* semantic names only; raw hex/rgba values are forbidden in new contracts.
rawValueRestrictions.shadow: Reference shadow.* semantic names or elevation.*.
rawValueRestrictions.typography: Reference typography.scale.* entries; no ad-hoc font sizes.
rawValueRestrictions.motion: Reference motion.* durations/easings; PageSpec motion is the closed pattern vocabulary.

enforced: primitive/component token references resolve against token-catalog.json (verify_all)
every semantic token resolves in both themes (verify_all)
convention: choosing which semantic token a NEW component uses (design review)
overrides: PageSpecs carry no per-instance style or token override field; styling is owned by section/component contracts. There is therefore nothing token-shaped to validate inside a PageSpec.
